```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CV_EjFjU4_YPdWVILooLXcj8P7VqWXeUgolHozslzVE/edit?usp=sharing" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()
cv <- gs %>%
  range_read("cv-sp") %>%
  mutate(
    DATES = case_when(
      is.na(START) & is.na(END) ~ "",
      is.na(START) ~ as.character(END),
      is.na(END) ~ paste(format(as.Date(START), "%Y"), format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), sep = " - "),
      START == END ~ as.character(START),
      TRUE ~ paste(START, END, sep = " - ")
    )
  )

info <- gs %>%
  range_read("info") %>%
  filter(lg %in% c("bt", "sp")) %>%
  select(INFORMATION, DESCRIPTION) %>%
  tibble::deframe() %>%
  as.list()
```

tex <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  gsub("\\s*\\|\\s*", ", ", x)
}

cat("\\begin{cvskills}\n")
cat(paste0("\\cvskill{", tex(skills$SKILL), "}{", tex(skills$DESCRIPTION), "}"
           , collapse = "\n"))
cat("\n\\end{cvskills}\n")

```{r results='asis', eval= params$info}

library(tidyverse)

flatten_dir <- "flattened_pdfs"

if (!dir.exists(flatten_dir)) {
  dir.create(flatten_dir)
}

flatten_pdfs <- function(pattern, path = ".") {

  files <- list.files(
    path = path,
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE,
    pattern = pattern
  ) %>%
    normalizePath(winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE) %>%
    unique() %>%
    discard(~ str_detect(.x, "/flattened_pdfs/"))

  purrr::map_chr(files, function(x) {

    flat <- file.path(
      flatten_dir,
      basename(x)
    )

    system2(
      "qpdf",
      c(
        "--flatten-annotations=all",
        shQuote(x),
        shQuote(flat)
      )
    )

    normalizePath(
      flat,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = TRUE
    )
  })
}

files <- list.files(
  path = ".",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.pdf$"
) %>%
  discard(~ str_detect(.x, "/flattened_pdfs/"))

img2print <- files %>%
  keep(str_detect(., "info|CV")) %>%
  enframe(value = "path") %>%
  mutate(
    name = basename(gsub("\\.pdf$", "", path)),
    path = gsub("^\\./", "", path),
    sort = case_when(
      grepl("dni", name) ~ 1,
      grepl("ruc", name) ~ 2,
      grepl("rnp", name) ~ 3
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(sort) %>%
  drop_na(sort) %>%
  mutate(
    chunk = paste0(
      "\\includepdf[pagecommand={}, scale=1, pages={-}]{",
      path,
      "}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(chunk)

cat(img2print, sep = "\n")
```

```{r results='asis'}
img2print <- flatten_pdfs(paste0(job$FILE, collapse = "|")) %>% 
  enframe() %>% 
  mutate(
    pages = str_extract(
      value,
      "(?<=--)[0-9.]+(?=\\.pdf$)"
    ),
    pages = str_replace_all(pages, "\\.", ","),
    pages = if_else(is.na(pages), "-", pages),
    chunk = paste0(
      "\\includepdf[pagecommand={}, scale=0.9, pages={",
      pages,
      "}]{",
      value,
      "}"
    )
  ) %>% 
  pull(chunk)

cat(img2print, sep = "\n")
```
